scripts.test:tz: TZ=Pacific/Auckland vitest run && TZ=America/Los_Angeles vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && ngc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && rm -rf packed.tmp && mkdir packed.tmp && for p in core dom angular; do (cd packages/$p/dist && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../packed.tmp >/dev/null) || exit 1; done && (cd packages/theme && npm pack --pack-destination ../../packed.tmp >/dev/null) && rm -rf packed && mv packed.tmp packed && ls packed
